name: West Virginia University
campus: WVU School of Nursing - Bridgeport Campus

2023.rateExcludedReason: Its annual security report's on-campus figures for the Morgantown campus include incidents at J.W. Ruby Memorial Hospital, whose patients, visitors and staff are not in its FTE. So a rate per student would not measure its campus population. It has no rate; its counts are shown. Source: West Virginia University 2026 Clery report (statistics 2023-2025), Morgantown Campus table: "Eleven of the reportable domestic violence reports occurred at J.W. Ruby Memorial Hospital" (2023) and "Nine of the reportable domestic violence reports occurred at J.W. Ruby Memorial Hospital" (2024), https://police.wvu.edu/files/d/a70956c9-a391-4974-bc9c-493246382c47/2026-clery-report.pdf; 2024 report (statistics 2021-2023), 2021 on-campus motor vehicle theft: "Two vehicle thefts were reported from the Ruby Memorial Hospital Parking lot.", https://police.wvu.edu/files/d/2df4543f-0601-4887-a718-90b54e12641d/2024-clery-report.pdf
